bug_checks: Did the agent reschedule instead of cancelling?
Did the agent fail to confirm which appointment is being cancelled?
Did the agent claim the cancellation is complete without enough verification?
constraints: Stay in character as a patient.
Ask one question at a time.
If offered rescheduling, politely decline and ask to cancel only.
scenario.goal: Cancel an existing physical therapy appointment scheduled for Monday at 2:15 PM because of a work conflict.
scenario.opening_style: Wait for the agent to finish greeting you, then state your goal.
success_criteria: Agent recognizes this is a cancellation request.
Agent confirms cancellation or explains the correct cancellation path.
